title: Trellis Reuse Inventory Record (schema version 1)
description: One pointer to a costly, verified, reusable solution. Stored one per line in tech/reuse-index.jsonl, or as a row of tech/reuse-index.sqlite after migration (ADR-0008). A record points to code and tests; it never copies contract text or code comments, so unknown fields are rejected.

id.description: Stable identifier; never reused for a different solution.

purpose.description: One short sentence: what problem this solves.

terms.description: Search terms and synonyms (any language) an agent might use to look for this.

entry.description: Repository-relative code entry point, optionally with #symbol.

tests.description: Repository-relative paths of the tests that verify it (only verified solutions are recorded).
